CLIP LENGTH: 24.6s
[+000.0s] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Alexander grabbing Juliana's shoulder as she recoils.
[+001.7s] ALEXANDER (Sharp, Alarmed): "You're hurt."
[+003.0s] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.
[+003.6s] JULIANA (Strained, Minimizing): "It is nothing."
[+005.6s] ACTION: Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.
[+005.6s] CAMERA: Tight close-up of the fresh riding-crop laceration cut across Juliana's shoulder.
[+009.6s] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.
[+010.8s] ALEXANDER (Seething, Dangerous): "Who did this?"
[+012.6s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana averting her eyes, her head bowed in quiet resignation.
[+014.3s] JULIANA (Subdued, Weary): "It does not matter."
[+016.6s] CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.
[+019.6s] ACTION: Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.
[+019.6s] ALEXANDER (Demanding, Stern): "Who?"
[+022.8s] JULIANA (Quiet, Apprehensive): "Lady Catherine."

CLIP LENGTH: 23.8s
[+000.0s] ACTION: Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
[+000.2s] CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.
[+000.2s] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Pleading): "My lady—"
[+001.5s] ACTION: The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
[+001.8s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.
[+002.0s] NOBLEWOMAN (Furious, Threatening): "Do you want the same punishment?"
[+004.5s] CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.
[+004.6s] PRUDENCE (Terrified, Murmuring): "No, my lady."
[+006.5s] ACTION: Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
[+006.8s] CAMERA: Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.
[+007.0s] SOUND FX: Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
[+008.8s] CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.
[+009.0s] NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Gleeful): "That is where clever little servants belong."
[+012.5s] CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.
[+012.6s] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Cold, Resolute): "Let her think I am only a maid."
[+015.2s] ACTION: Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed w…
[+015.2s] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.
[+015.5s] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Determined, Defiant): "Let her believe I am ignorant."
[+019.6s] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Steely, Unstoppable): "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."

CLIP LENGTH: 30.1s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.
[+000.9s] ACTION: Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.
[+001.2s] ALEXANDER (Pleading, Agonized): "Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this."
[+002.8s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.
[+006.6s] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.
[+008.2s] JULIANA (Quiet, Unwavering): "I must."
[+010.2s] ALEXANDER (Terrified for Her): "They will tear your hands apart."
--- HARD CUT TO A DIFFERENT MOMENT OF THE SHOW ---
[+013.1s] ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
[+013.1s] CAMERA: Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.
[+014.6s] ALEXANDER (Strangled, Weeping): "Please..."
[+015.1s] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.
[+016.6s] CAMERA: Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
[+017.1s] ACTION: Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.
[+017.6s] JULIANA (Gasping in Pain): "No..."
[+019.1s] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.
[+020.3s] CLARISSA (O.S.) (Gleeful, Derisive): "Look at her hands."
[+021.3s] CAMERA: Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.
[+021.9s] CLARISSA (Mocking, Spiteful): "The lady has finally found something worthy of her."
[+025.1s] ACTION: Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
[+025.3s] GERALD (Taunting, Cruel): "Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden."

CLIP LENGTH: 25.2s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.
[+002.0s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining): "Rupert..."
[+003.9s] CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.
[+003.9s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Commanding): "Stop this!"
[+005.6s] CAMERA: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.
[+006.0s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm): "She is innocent."
[+008.0s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant): "She saved me!"
[+010.0s] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.
[+010.4s] JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved): "Your Grace..."
[+012.1s] CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.
[+012.2s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting): "I know what happened to me!"
[+014.9s] CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.
[+015.4s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning): "I was poisoned!"
[+017.5s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing): "And you... you knew!"
[+020.2s] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.
[+020.8s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Choking, Weakening): "Catherine knew!"
[+022.8s] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Gasping): "They have been—"
[+024.0s] ACTION: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

CLIP LENGTH: 46.4s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Close-up overhead shot of Juliana asleep on her pillow as her eyelids flutter open, gasping and coughing violently from the choking smoke.
[+001.4s] ACTION: Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.
[+003.9s] ACTION: Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.
[+004.4s] JULIANA (Screaming, Terrified): "Alexander!"
[+007.4s] CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana swings her bare legs out of bed onto the floor, trembling with panic.
[+008.4s] JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting): "Alexander!"
[+010.7s] CAMERA: Low-angle close shot of the bedroom door glowing intensely, fire licking the wooden floorboards as smoke pours inward.
[+014.1s] ACTION: Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.
[+015.7s] JULIANA (Muffled, Weeping): "Alexander..."
[+017.4s] SOUND FX: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
[+018.0s] CAMERA: Framed in the doorway engulfed by blazing orange light, Alexander bursts in, his dark hair flying, looking like an imposing guardian amid the smoke.
[+018.7s] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Urgency): "Juliana! Get up!"
[+020.7s] CAMERA: Wide tracking shot as Alexander rushes across the burning, smoke-choked room toward her bed.
[+022.4s] ACTION: Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.
[+024.4s] JULIANA (Breathless, Distressed): "What happened?"
[+026.0s] ALEXANDER (Grim, Urgent): "Fire."
[+026.8s] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot past Alexander toward the blazing threshold of the main room, beams collapsing across the doorway.
[+028.7s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander wrapping a heavy coat tightly around Juliana's shoulders.
[+030.4s] ACTION: Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.
[+031.1s] ALEXANDER (Firm, Protective): "Stay close to me."
[+034.4s] CAMERA: Reverse shot from behind them facing the burning door frame as wall-high flames roar, completely sealing their exit.
[+035.9s] ACTION: Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.
[+037.4s] JULIANA (Panic-Stricken, Choked): "We cannot get through!"
[+039.9s] ALEXANDER (Resolute, Calm Under Pressure): "Then we go another way."
[+042.9s] SOUND FX: Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.

CLIP LENGTH: 40.7s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.
[+000.0s] CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive): "A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."
[+004.0s] ACTION: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
[+005.2s] CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.
[+005.4s] FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical): "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
[+010.0s] CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.
[+010.2s] CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering): "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
[+014.0s] CAMERA: Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
[+015.0s] CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional): "Name your price."
[+017.0s] CAMERA: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
[+017.6s] FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding): "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
[+024.7s] CAMERA: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
[+025.4s] CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous): "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
[+028.7s] CAMERA: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
[+029.2s] FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold): "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
[+034.0s] CAMERA: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
[+034.7s] CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating): "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
[+038.6s] FATHER THOMAS (Grave): "For as long as it holds."

CLIP LENGTH: 41.8s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.
[+000.6s] THUG WITH CAP (Menacing Snarl): "Get out of the way!"
[+002.3s] CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.
[+002.3s] JULIANA (Steely, Fearless): "No."
[+003.2s] ACTION: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.
[+003.6s] JULIANA (Gasping Cry): "Ah!"
[+005.3s] CAMERA: Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
[+005.8s] ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
[+009.3s] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.
[+009.3s] JULIANA (Broken, Sobbing): "My mother's plants..."
[+012.3s] CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.
[+013.1s] BALD THUG (Cruel, Laughing): "Look at her! Crying over weeds!"
[+015.8s] ACTION: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.
[+015.8s] JULIANA (Screaming): "Stop!"
[+017.8s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.
[+019.0s] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.
[+019.3s] ACTION: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
[+023.3s] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.
[+026.3s] JULIANA (Whispered Breath, Stunned): "Alexander..."
[+029.3s] CAMERA: Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.
[+031.3s] CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.
[+031.8s] ACTION: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
[+034.3s] CAMERA: Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.
[+034.8s] THUG WITH CAP (Challenging, Arrogant): "What? You want to fight us, veteran?"
[+038.6s] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.
[+039.8s] SOUND FX: Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.

CLIP LENGTH: 30.3s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Close-up on the ledger as Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches it out of Juliana's grip.
[+000.5s] ACTION: Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.
[+001.5s] JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate): "Barbara, don't!"
[+003.0s] SOUND FX: A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.
[+003.8s] CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing together on the cathedral steps. Clarissa clasps a gloved hand to her mouth in mock shock before bursting into gleeful laughter.
[+005.0s] CLARISSA (Gleeful, Mocking): "Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!"
[+008.4s] GERALD (Smug, Cruel): "Perhaps that is where it belongs."
[+009.0s] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking down at the ground, tears streaming down her pale cheeks.
[+011.5s] ACTION: Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
[+012.5s] CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana's trembling hand reaching toward the leather ledger resting in the puddle.
[+015.0s] CAMERA: Wide shot of Juliana kneeling on the damp ground as the tall Mysterious Bearded Man strides purposefully into frame toward her.
[+016.5s] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.
--- HARD CUT TO A DIFFERENT MOMENT OF THE SHOW ---
[+020.5s] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Gerald standing high on the stone steps, grinning arrogantly as he points an accusatory finger down at them.
[+021.0s] GERALD (Mocking, Arrogant): "Look at you."
[+022.5s] GERALD (Scornful, Spiteful): "A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!"
[+027.5s] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Lethally Cold): "Choose your next words carefully."

CLIP LENGTH: 30.0s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.
[+000.4s] ACTION: The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
[+000.7s] SOUND FX: Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
[+004.1s] CAMERA: Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.
[+004.6s] ACTION: The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.
[+008.6s] LOYALIST FIGHTER (Whispering, Cold): "Sleep."
[+010.4s] CAMERA: Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.
[+014.6s] CART DRIVER (Relieved, Firm): "The road is clear."
[+015.8s] LOYALIST FIGHTER (Resolute): "Tell the Duke."
--- HARD CUT TO A DIFFERENT MOMENT OF THE SHOW ---
[+016.8s] CAMERA: Slow dramatic tracking shot moving backward in front of Alexander as he strides purposefully through the deep snow, the wooden chapel looming in the distance behind him.
[+017.1s] ALEXANDER (Powerful, Roaring Defiance): "No more hiding."
[+019.1s] ALEXANDER (Fierce, Unyielding): "I am taking back my house."
[+021.8s] ACTION: Alexander marches forward unstoppably, his long coat fluttering in the winter wind as his icy gaze locks forward.
[+026.6s] CAMERA: Dramatic push-in close-up directly onto Alexander's scarred, fierce face as he speaks with absolute conviction.
[+026.6s] ALEXANDER (Passionate, Unstoppable Vow): "And I am bringing my wife home."
[+029.4s] ACTION: Alexander's eyes burn with furious determination as the screen cuts sharply to black.

CLIP LENGTH: 55.0s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.
[+000.3s] ALEXANDER (Desperate): "Then where is she?"
[+002.5s] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.
[+003.0s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Wailing): "They arrested her!"
[+007.0s] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.
[+007.5s] ALEXANDER (Stunned): "Arrested?"
[+009.3s] CAMERA: Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.
[+009.4s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Despairing): "Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!"
[+013.5s] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.
[+015.3s] ALEXANDER (Shouting, Incredulous): "But she saved you!"
[+017.5s] CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.
[+017.7s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping): "I told them!"
[+020.5s] CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.
[+021.0s] ALEXANDER (Furious): "You told them the truth!"
[+023.0s] CAMERA: Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.
[+023.3s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Agonized): "They called her a witch!"
[+026.5s] CAMERA: Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.
[+027.3s] ALEXANDER (Horrified): "Juliana... is in a cell?"
[+031.0s] CAMERA: Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.
[+031.3s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weak, Trembling): "She was taken before a magistrate."
[+034.3s] CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.
[+034.4s] ALEXANDER (Barking): "And?!"
[+035.5s] CAMERA: Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.
[+035.7s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping): "They condemned her."
[+038.0s] ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Gasping): "No."
[+038.5s] CAMERA: Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.
[+039.5s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Solemn, Shattered): "She is to be executed."
[+042.5s] CAMERA: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.
[+043.7s] ALEXANDER (Guttural, Demanding): "When?"
[+045.5s] CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.
[+046.7s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling): "After the wedding."
[+049.3s] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.
[+050.0s] ALEXANDER (Cold, Menacing): "What wedding?"
[+052.3s] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Grim): "Rupert... and Catherine's."

CLIP LENGTH: 23.1s
[+000.0s] GERALD (Mocking, Spiteful): "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"
[+003.1s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.
[+003.7s] ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing): "Choose your next words carefully."
[+005.6s] CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.
[+005.8s] GERALD (Shouting, Dramatic): "You hear that? He threatens me again!"
[+007.7s] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.
[+008.1s] CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern): "I have received a complaint of theft."
--- HARD CUT TO A DIFFERENT MOMENT OF THE SHOW ---
[+009.9s] CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.
[+012.6s] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.
[+014.4s] CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.
[+014.4s] GERALD (Provoking, Smirking): "What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?"
[+017.3s] JULIANA (Whispering, Terrified): "Don't!"
[+018.1s] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana clutching her dress collar in acute panic.
[+019.1s] ALEXANDER (V.O.) (Haunted, Resolute): "One blow would end this."
[+019.6s] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable stepping up behind Alexander, holding his truncheon firmly across Alexander's chest to restrain him, cutting to a tight close-up of Alexander's smoldering eyes.
[+021.1s] ALEXANDER (V.O.) (Pained, Selfless): "But one blow would destroy her life."

CLIP LENGTH: 45.2s
[+000.0s] CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.
[+002.2s] ALEXANDER (Furious, Cold): "You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."
[+006.4s] CAMERA: Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.
[+006.4s] CATHERINE (Gasping, Lying): "I didn't know!"
[+008.2s] ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Biting): "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
[+010.7s] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.
[+010.8s] ALEXANDER (Booming, Condemning): "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."
[+017.0s] CATHERINE (Trembling, Stunned): "Wife?!"
--- HARD CUT TO A DIFFERENT MOMENT OF THE SHOW ---
[+018.7s] CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
[+018.7s] SOUND FX: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
[+019.7s] ACTION: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
[+020.6s] HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern): "No one will bow yet!"
[+023.0s] CAMERA: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
[+025.2s] CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
[+025.4s] ACTION: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
[+025.4s] HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe): "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
[+033.4s] CAMERA: Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.
[+033.7s] HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Official): "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
[+038.0s] CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.
[+038.4s] HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute): "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
[+041.2s] HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning): "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."

CLIP LENGTH: 36.8s
